grh_105408ca8f7afa3a131d.title: A Short History of Bac Ha
paragraphs: After American soldiers kill the prized water buffalo of a Vietnamese village elder, relations between the nearby village of Bac Ha and an American firebase begin sliding toward open hostility. Private Eckstein, who has built trust with local villagers, persuades his commanders to let him enter Bac Ha alone and unarmed rather than turn the dispute into another combat operation. He meets the elders, acknowledges that he cannot justify the soldiers' act, and works out restitution in the form of replacement buffalo. The settlement appears to offer a rare escape from the cycle of retaliation, but on a return visit Eckstein is killed. The elder carries his body back to the firebase and tells the Americans that those responsible for the killing have lost the village's support. Grieving on both sides, the elder and the commander agree that the village gates will reopen and that future trouble should be met first with conversation.

[[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]] carried the broadcast. The cast includes Tommy Cook, Keith Andes, Daws Butler, Marvin Miller, and Lillian Buyeff. Other credited names include Elliott Lewis as director, Elliott Lewis as producer, and Andy Nance as writer.
The broadcast is also associated with [[org|org.9b0a0ccffce2f7d3|Sears, Roebuck and Company]].

grh_10d609e2835c5654311e.title: The Night Before Christmas
paragraphs: On Christmas Eve, Lord Widdickham asks Holmes for help after receiving an extortion note threatening the valuable presents at his family celebration unless a large payment is made. Holmes recognizes the disguised handwriting as that of one of Professor Moriarty's trusted associates and realizes the thieves are using the holiday crowds and Santa Claus disguises to move unnoticed. The gang follows Watson and Mrs. Hudson and becomes entangled with Watson's sack of children's gifts, but Holmes traces the criminals to a nearby house, surrounds them with police and his street helpers, and recovers the stolen valuables. He then directs part of the reward toward the children caught up in the case.
